newsitem.title: USA: Successories Dec same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Successories Dec same-store sales up.

text.p: Successories Inc said comparable-store sales increased 10 percent for company-owned locations for the five weeks ended January 4, while total retail sales for the month increased 16 percent.
It said total sales for December 1996 were up 22 percent to a record $8.8 million compared to $7.2 million a year ago.

"The retail division exceeded budgetary expectations for the period," said president James Beltrame in a statement. "We also expect a strong gross margin for the quarter as these sales were built without any price promotions versus last year when we used December to liquidate some of our older inventory," Beltrame said.
He said the catalog division posted an 18 percent increase in revenues for the month.
"We also benefitted from a more focused circulation plan which had a positive impact on our prospect mailings," Beltrame added.
Successories is a specialty retailer and catalog company.
